contract_clause: CS-004 (superset permits gained catches); tasks.md T050 literal clause 'negative control: a run catching more PASSes' -- this fixture is NOT one of the 8 contract-table rows verbatim; it is a task-line-driven addition, derived from and consistent with CS-004's own definition ('superset=true iff no row has old=CAUGHT and new=MISSED'), never contradicting it. See PAIRED_MUTATION_NOTE.md sibling discussion.
note: OLD's manifest [g_marker, g_noop] does not include g_extra at all, so D_extra (drops EXTRA_MARKER) is MISSED by OLD -- not old=CAUGHT, so no superset violation is possible for this row regardless of NEW's outcome. NEW's manifest [g_marker, g_noop, g_extra] DOES catch D_extra via g_extra. A run where NEW catches strictly MORE than OLD -- old=MISSED, new=CAUGHT -- MUST PASS (exit 0, counts.gained=1): the §11.4.201(1) false-positive guard for CS-004's own directionality (old=CAUGHT & new=MISSED is the ONLY violating shape; old=MISSED & new=CAUGHT is never one).
